record.decision_rule: The fix is accepted when the after arm has no not_drafted caused by the diagnosed cause across all 12 attempts and drafts at least as many as the before arm; any not_drafted in the after arm is reported with its reply. No incomplete or repaired object is ever accepted.
record.diagnosis: Before: 1 of 12 attempts not drafted, the rehearsal's request, both of its calls refused as not JSON. Each reply finished with finish_reason stop at 316 and 309 completion tokens against a 2048 ceiling, so neither was truncated at the token limit; neither carried text after the object. Inside the object the value of world_tempo, whose range is 0.75 to 1.25, was written as 1 and 25 on two lines, so the endpoint's constrained decoding did not hold the bounded-number grammar the strict json_schema requested. world_tempo is the only control whose range runs above 1, and every reply of this arm that parsed left it null.
record.fix: Each range control is stated in the draft schema as an enum of the values on its registry grid (minimum, then each step to maximum) rather than as a number with minimum and maximum. The local validator still checks every reply against the schema sent and against the registry; nothing incomplete is accepted.
limitations: Twelve attempts per arm on six requests; a rare failure of another kind is not ruled out by this sample.

Measured through draft_appearance with the default reference of the first proposable profile and three fresh evidence references, not through the route in a made world; the drafter sees only those inputs.
other_observations: After: one draft of 'make this place feel warmer and less busy' was refused unregistered by the validator, because it set surface-finish to its current value without naming the module that owns it. Choice controls were enums in both arms; this is the drafter restating controls, not an unreadable reply.
Both arms: each proposal drawn for the two-part and single-bright requests moved 6 to 8 controls, the restating defect recorded under proposal-2.
record.question: Does draft_appearance fill the appearance form for requests in a world whose evidence catalogue holds three photographs, and what is the cause when it does not?
record.verdict: Accepted. After: 12 of 12 drafted and 0 not drafted, against 11 of 12 and 1 before, and no reply wrote a number across a line break. The endpoint wrote enum members in a 17-digit form (0.65000000000000002), which is valid JSON and equal to the member.
